text:
lee: Follow-up from the canary that tripped yesterday. We didn't have an automated mitigation path and had to manually cut the rollout. Need concrete ownership + quick wins.

lee: Root cause recap: flag rolled to 9% with auto_rollback=false. Alerting fired at 09:42 but flag-controller wasn't subscribed to the alert stream, so no flip.

pat: I'll take the controller subscription work. Goal: subscribe to alertstream, evaluate rollback_rules, flip flags, and attach audit metadata (incident id, trigger metric, rollout percent). POC in 4 days.

izzy: I'll own deploy-time guardrails. Quick mitigation: deploy-bot should block any rollout>1% unless auto_rollback=true or a two-owner override is explicitly recorded. I can ship this tonight to staging.

morgan: I'll draft blast-radius defaults and per-service caps. Suggestion: new frontend flags start at 0.5%, backend-infra 5%, sensitive services hard cap 1%. Will post RFC by EOD Thu.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: logged deploy job=ci/6120 rollout=9 auto_rollback=false -> flagged.

pat: Proposed rollback_rules schema (pseudo):

```
rollback_rules:
  - name: p99_latency
    metric: service.p99_ms
    op: ">"
    value: 240
    window: 3m
    action: rollback
  - name: error_rate
    metric: service.error_rate
    op: ">="
    value: 0.02
    window: 5m
    action: rollback
```

izzy: Implementation note: deploy-bot will require a signed 'override' field that lists two approvers. No override -> fail.

morgan: Also proposing a "quarantine" mitigation: controller flips traffic for flagged users into a degraded pool and runs a 3-minute smoke test against canary variant. If smoke passes, slowly resume; else full rollback. Add to RFC.

lee: Action items + target timestamps:
- pat: controller subscription POC -> +4 bd -> 1923900000
- izzy: deploy-bot preflight + two-owner override -> next business day -> 1923550000
- morgan: blast-radius RFC + per-service caps -> EOD Thu -> 1923600000
- infra: smoke-job template for quarantine flow -> +3 bd -> 1923700000

lee: Please react with :white_check_mark: here on completion and paste PR/ticket links. I'll triage follow-ups into the postmortem ticket (INC-2024-321). If anyone hits a blocker, @eng-platform. :mag_right:
